title: A console word also counts for a proposal that changes the core, on the same conditions

looked_in: check 89 at c94debd4: the console reading refuses unless kind is loosen or retire and touches_core is empty
the person's answer to Q-20261023-office-04, committed verbatim at 881f5119
HP-016's notes, which kept a core change as words in a window until the person said otherwise

changes.change: Item 6 becomes: the console form counts for every proposal that needs the person's word, that is kind loosen or retire, or touches_core not empty, whatever its kind. A tighten or reshape with an empty touches_core needs no word, and a console word on it is still refused, so the record never carries a permission nothing asked for. Items 1 to 5 and HP-017's login reading are unchanged.

The row refusing a console word on a proposal touching the core becomes accepted: a core change of kind tighten landed on a valid console word passes. A new refused row: a console word on a tighten with an empty touches_core.
The sign step also appears for a proposal touching the core, on the same conditions; the 'no decision here' panel goes. Still none for a tighten or reshape that touches nothing in the core.

notes: A loosening that touches rule 1, on the person's word said in the intake seat's window and committed verbatim at 881f5119. It answers the part of INC-20261023-01 that HP-016 left to the person. What it does not reach: a harness proposal is landed by its owner seat. The person's own files stay the person's hand, held by check 41 whatever a proposal says: the safety policy, the approvals and the login file. So a console permission lets an owner land a core proposal. It never writes a safety value or hands over the bench, which the plan-approval decision kept as the person's own acts. Nothing lands a core change on a console word until 8.3's words and this check both say so.
